definition: J_n,k = sum_h W_h mean_i_in_(h,n),r [sum_e w_e Q_e,i,r/(N_p E_g)]; D_k=J_1024,k-J_512,k.
interval_method: 95% Student-t across four independent randomized layouts (df=3); each layout is averaged over eight measured transport realizations.

limitations: This supplementary half-layout contrast retains the prior failed spatial checks; it does not certify spatial convergence.
Four layout means provide only four independent repetitions, with Student-t assumptions and broad regional intervals.
Area fractions, electrode weights, scoring and input energies remain fixed; their uncertainties are not estimated here.
Ranking stability for reference, C44=1 GPa and SiC-derived rate cases does not establish ranking stability across the six-dimensional search.
Within-layout transport intervals are conditional on the recorded sites; cross-layout intervals include both position and finite-transport variation.
The 512 subset is an analysis of retained fine-run outputs, not an independently executed new 512-site experiment.
relative_definition: d_k=D_k/J_1024,k; relative intervals summarize four paired layout ratios, not a ratio of pooled means.
selection_rule: Within each physical stratum in recorded site order, retain ranks 0,2,4,... before examining responses; no new transport.
